title: Policies
description: The `policies` global (_data/policies.json): every policy in the syllabus Policies section (the `<policies>` component renders one <details> per key, forced open in the printed PDF). Key order is display order. The `required` list is exactly what Meredith College requires on every syllabus — the attendance policy and the five College statements. College statements use the College's approved wording from my.meredith.edu/pages/syllabus_statements or reference it by link; never paraphrase one.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editor validation.

ai.description: Course AI-use summary; `href` links the full policy page.

attendance.description: Attendance Policy (Meredith-required). If attendance affects the grade — any in-class credit category in grading.json — state expectations AND consequences.

honorCode.description: Honor Code Statement (Meredith-required). By reference until the College's approved wording is pasted into `body`.

dei.description: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Statement (Meredith-required). By reference until the College's approved wording is pasted into `body`.

disabilities.description: Accessibility Statement (Meredith-required): Disability Services contact and the accommodation process.

titleIX.description: Sexual Misconduct / Title IX Statement (Meredith-required). By reference until the College's approved wording is pasted into `body`.

collegePolicies.description: Pointer to the College's full syllabus-statements page for anything not stated above.

href.description: Optional link to the full policy or the College's page.

hrefText.description: Link text; the template defaults to "Read the full policy".
